##### Project general facts

Jaddaf Beach Oasis by Azizi Developments is a residential development that combines the calm of a beachside setting with the convenience of city infrastructure. Two elegant towers complement each other in harmony, with a contemporary, refined design accentuated by flowing lines and curved balconies with glass railings. The development offers a carefully curated selection of studios, spacious one-bedroom apartments and luxurious penthouses, together with retail units at street level.

Residents enjoy a beach-style lagoon pool with changing cabins, a children's pool and a sun terrace, together with separate gyms for men and women, a sauna and a steam room. A private cinema, an indoor multipurpose hall, indoor and outdoor children's play areas, a barbecue area, landscaped gardens, walking paths and social zones add variety, while accessible facilities, lifts, parking and round-the-clock security provide comfort and peace of mind.

Every residence is thoughtfully designed to maximise natural light and open up panoramic views of the creek and the skyline. Apartments are fitted with premium kitchen appliances and modern finishes, creating comfortable homes for professionals, couples and investors. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf is a culturally rich waterfront district along Dubai Creek, combining heritage, commerce and leisure. The Dubai Culture Village, the Al Jaddaf Waterfront promenade, luxury hotels such as Palazzo Versace and a growing choice of restaurants, cafes and parks give the area a calm, characterful atmosphere, with panoramic views across the creek towards the historic heart of the city and the modern skyline.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Al Jaddaf metro station is close by. Wafi Mall and Dubai Healthcare City are a short drive away, Dubai International Airport and the Dubai World Trade Centre are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall are within comfortable reach.

Al Jaddaf is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most central waterfront addresses in Dubai. Proximity to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Creek views, metro access and competitive prices compared with neighbouring prime areas underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
